scope: ObfuscationOS refactor/ext4-layout (da58575) against the kernel-sdk export of d2d58b0 (ABI 76): CI fast-lane steps, artifact tests, cross-tests, the ext4 two-boot persistence test and the native ext4 units, compared with ObfuscationOS main 016b7ab on kernel main 05c985e (ABI 75).
claims: kernel-sdk-check, uapi-test, libc-test, distro_image, linux-driver-compat, rootfs-simplefs, rootfs-ext4 and qemu-distro --require-native pass on x86_64, arm32 and ppc; compat-test passes on x86_64

the 1290 OS artifact tests pass on x86_64 in one interpreter and with one interpreter per module, with the same per-module results as the baseline; two earlier runs under heavy parallel load died before finishing (xmake run; two-process run with SIGSEGV in pathlib), see summary.artifact_tests
the cross-tests pass on x86_64, as on the baseline
the ext4 two-boot persistence test passes; its offline content is byte-identical to the baseline run
the ext4 tests/native units that compile standalone produce the same code against both SDKs

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple, sha256-verified), installed with --systoolchain_dir
